intro: Return to Denalan is an Alliance quest connecting the botanists investigating corruption within Teldrassil. After studying the mossy tumors afflicting local timberlings, Rellian Greenspyre sends you back south to Lake Al'Ameth to assist Denalan with an alarming new discovery.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have just received word that Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth has discovered what may be the cause of the tumors that plague the timberlings. Please speak with him, and tell him I sent you.
Make haste, friend; he needs our help.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, so Rellian sent you to aid me. I am glad you arrived here so soon.
I have discovered something quite disturbing!

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
